name: Eitrigg's Wisdom
label: Quest
description: Eitrigg's Wisdom: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It had been thought that Rend was slain decades ago.

Seek out the wisdom of Eitrigg, friend. None know the workings of the Blackrock better than he and if what is written here bares truth, Eitrigg should be informed. No person should be denied the right of vengeance.
You will find him in Orgrimmar.
Once you have spoken with Eitrigg, confer with the Warchief to find out what he wishes to do about this problem.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Can you not see that I must not be interrupted?
